# BAD-083 — admin lint: Rail.tsx's sign-out navigation trips no-location-assign-relative-destination

## Brief
npm run lint in admin/ has exactly one standing warning: admin/src/components/Rail.tsx:102, @next/next/no-location-assign-relative-destination, for window.location.href = '/login' at the end of signOut. Read the site before changing it. The rule's usual argument -- that a full page load throws away the client router's cache and prefetch -- is the point here, not the cost: signOut has just POSTed to /api/auth/signout to clear the cookie, and a router.push() would carry the RSC cache of an authenticated session across the boundary unless paired with a router.refresh(). The comment two lines above already says the route handler answers JSON rather than a redirect so the navigation happens client-side. So this is probably a disable comment carrying that reasoning, not a code change -- but confirm that reading against how the rest of the dashboard signs out, and if router.push() plus router.refresh() is genuinely equivalent here, say why. Either way npm run lint should end at zero problems, so the next real warning is visible.
